definitions.explanation: A female sibling who is younger than oneself. Used for both one's own younger sister and others' younger sisters.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：noentry⟧です。
examples.english: My younger sister is a middle school student.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えています→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: I'm teaching Japanese to my younger sister.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{可愛|かわい}い→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧です。
examples.english: My younger sister is very cute.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りました→入る：00494_hairu⟧。⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦そうです→そうです：03098_soudesu⟧。
examples.english: My younger sister entered university this year. She says she wants to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五歳|ごさい}→歳：10017_sai⟧でした。⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しくなかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です。
examples.english: When my younger sister was born, I was five years old. At first I wasn't happy about it, but now we get along well.

notes:
{妹|いもうと} means younger sister. Unlike {姉|あね}/{兄|あに}, the humble/polite distinction is less strict for younger siblings.

FAMILY TERM SYSTEM:
- {妹|いもうと}: younger sister (your own or general)
- {妹|いもうと}さん: younger sister (polite, someone else's)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {妹|いもうと}がいる: to have a younger sister
- {妹|いもうと}みたいに: like a younger sister
- {妹|いもうと}{分|ぶん}: someone like a younger sister (figurative)

FAMILY TERMS (complete set):
- {兄|あに}/お{兄|にい}さん: older brother
- {姉|あね}/お{姉|ねえ}さん: older sister
- {弟|おとうと}/{弟|おとうと}さん: younger brother
- {妹|いもうと}/{妹|いもうと}さん: younger sister

NOTE:
{義妹|ぎまい} or {義理|ぎり}の{妹|いもうと} means 'sister-in-law' (younger).
